events.name: DISABLED
events.text: You have a terrible accident which almost cripples you. Your Movement Allowance values should always be read from the line above the normal in the Combat Statistics Table.

events.name: WIMP
events.text: In frightening situations you tend to pass out. Your Actions/Round value should always be read from the line above the normal in the Combat Statistics Table.

events.name: WEAK BONE STRUCTURE
events.text: Subtract 5 from Total Body Points.

events.name: DIMWITTED
events.text: Your Defensive and Perception Bonuses should always be read one line above the normal in the Combat Statistics Table.

events.name: SERIOUS CRIME COMMITTED
events.text: Guilty or not you are sentenced for a serious crime for which you spend 1d6+3 years in a labor camp. Incarceration affects characteristics: +3 STR CON CHA, -1 DEX INT WIS.

events.name: MINOR CRIME COMMITTED
events.text: You are found guilty of a minor crime resulting in 1d3 years in prison. Prison affects characteristics: +1 STR CHA, -1 CON.

events.name: CRIMINAL RECORD
events.text: You've taken part in some criminal activity and your name is recorded in criminal records—probably for the rest of your life.

events.name: BAD COMPANY
events.text: Unfortunately you've spent a lot of time in the wrong company. -1 to Credit Score (1 is the minimum).

events.name: TRAGIC ACCIDENT
events.text: Both your parents died in a terrible accident and you were sent to an orphanage. Credit Score is lowered by 3.

events.name: ISOLATED UPBRINGING
events.text: Raised in a restrictive, sheltered household. You start your adult life socially awkward with a minor community stigma.

events.name: SPOILED HEIR
events.text: Born into old money with heavy family strings attached. You carry an air of privilege that doesn't always translate to credit.

events.name: MILITARY HERITAGE
events.text: Spend two years in a military academy. Raise your INT to 7 if it is lower.

events.name: TECHNICAL TALENT
events.text: Spend two years in a technical university. Raise your INT to 12 if it is lower.

events.name: BUSINESS FAMILY
events.text: Attend a business school for two years. Raise your INT to 10 if it is lower.

events.name: MEDIA FAMILY
events.text: Enroll in a media college for two years. Raise your INT to 9 if it is lower.

events.name: MILITARY CONNECTIONS
events.text: You have the right connections within the military and may ignore all officer requirements.

events.name: APPRENTICE SCIENTIST
events.text: You may ignore requirements if you want to become a scientist.

events.name: AMATEUR PHOTOGRAPHER/WRITER
events.text: You ignore all requirements if you want to become a reporter.

events.name: BUSINESS SENSE
events.text: You ignore all requirements if you choose a background in administration/economy/law.

events.name: RESTLESS DRIFTER
events.text: Spent your youth bouncing from sector to sector, never settling down long enough to put down deep roots.

events.name: STREET HUSTLER
events.text: Grew up learning survival tricks on the blocks, relying on street smarts rather than formal structure.

events.name: SLICK SPEAKER
events.text: Excel at reading pressure points and driving negotiations under stress. Add +1 to CHA.

events.name: NATURAL TECHNICIAN
events.text: Innate grasp of hardware lock mechanics and electronic systems. Add +1 to INT.

events.name: SLENDER BODY
events.text: Move with natural grace agility and speed through tight physical spaces. Add +1 to DEX.

events.name: WEAPONS FANATIC
events.text: Intuitive understanding of ballistics firearm mechanics and recoil control. Add +1 to DEX.

events.name: MARTIAL ARTS TRAINING
events.text: Formal combat training in close-quarters defense and hand-to-hand. Add +2 CHA and +1 STR.

events.name: ANATOMICAL SIXTH SENSE
events.text: Hit people where it hurts most. Add +1 to your Offensive Bonus row.

events.name: SHARP SENSES
events.text: Exceptional situational awareness reacting to ambient threats. Add +1 to WIS.

events.name: STRONG WILL
events.text: Add +1 to WIS and +1 to MST.

events.name: CHARISMATIC VOICE
events.text: Raise your CHA by 2.

events.name: GOOD BODY CONTROL
events.text: Raise DEX by 1 and CON by 1.

events.name: CONTACT WITHIN A MEGACORP
events.text: Coordinate with your GM to establish a specific corporate contact for insider information or backchannel favors.

events.name: LUCKY STIFF
events.text: Win a small fortune on the lottery. Raise Credit Score by 5.

events.name: RELATIVE WITHIN THE POLICE DEPARTMENT
events.text: Trouble with the law are now resolved.

events.name: RESISTANT TO PAIN
events.text: Add +1 to your Body Points in each body part.

events.name: SOLE HEIR TO WEALTHY AUNT
events.text: Raise your Credit Score by 10.

events.name: GIFTED STUDENT
events.text: Add +2 to INT or WIS.

events.name: GIFTED BODY
events.text: Add +1 to any base attribute.

events.name: COMMANDO TRAINING
events.text: Elite-forces commando training. Add +2 to all base attributes +5 CHA and +2 Credit Score.
